summary: iter213 — Verified the new R2 native upload pipeline + opt-in daily Sora cron. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter213_clips_upload.py covering POST /api/maker/clips/upload happy-path (synthetic 2s 720×1280 MP4 → R2 upload returns source_type='r2', video_url on https://, poster_url populated via ffmpeg, slug fetchable via GET /api/clips/{slug}), invalid category 422, non-video mime 422, oversize >50MB 422 ('too large'), missing JWT 401/403, scheduler._job_daily_clip_seed early-return path when SCHEDULER_DAILY_CLIPS unset (log line 'daily_clip_seed disabled (SCHEDULER_DAILY_CLIPS=true to opt in)' captured), daily_clip_seed registered on AsyncIOScheduler at cron[hour='9', minute='0'], plus iter210/iter212 regression (/api/clips/categories 200 with 6 cats, /api/clips/feed 200, ?category=bogus 400). Frontend: Maker Settings → Workshop Clips (Feed) renders maker-clips-panel with clips-mode-tabs + clips-mode-url (default) + clips-mode-file; clicking file reveals clips-file-drop + clips-add-file (hidden input), clicking URL back hides them. Admin Settings → clips-seed-card defaults to model='sora-2-pro' with label 'sora-2-pro · 1024×1792 (recommended)', second option 'sora-2 · 1280×720 horizontal (cheaper)'. generate-one-clip-btn + purge-clips-seed-btn present. Did NOT trigger /admin/seed/clips/generate-one (paid + budget exceeded).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/clips.py:maker_upload_clip reads the full upload into memory (`data = await file.read()`) before R2 PUT. Fine at 50MB cap but a streaming multipart→boto3 pipe would lower peak RSS during concurrent uploads. Cosmetic.

routers/clips.py:maker_upload_clip writes the temp .mp4 with `delete=False` and never explicitly removes it (and same for .jpg). On success the OS will eventually GC /tmp, but a try/finally `os.unlink` would be tidier and keep /tmp small under load.

routers/clips.py:feed + get_clip still read `authorization` as a query param instead of a FastAPI Header dep (carried over from iter210 — flagged in iteration_60.json). The frontend sends Authorization as a header, so initial i_liked/i_saved hydration never fires for signed-in viewers. One-line fix: `authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)`. Low UX impact (self-corrects on first toggle). Not introduced by iter213 — pre-existing.

scheduler.py:_job_daily_clip_seed honors SCHEDULER_DAILY_CLIPS but the chosen model defaults to env `SCHEDULER_DAILY_CLIPS_MODEL` with fallback 'sora-2'. SettingsTab + clip_seeder default to 'sora-2-pro'. Minor inconsistency — if/when ops flips the cron on without setting the env var, the daily render would use the cheaper horizontal sora-2 model instead of the preferred vertical sora-2-pro. Consider aligning the default to 'sora-2-pro'.
